integrity: Analytical proof supplied, standalone exact-rational identity and numerical matrix verifier supplied. Prior unit-weight family credited; no independent scientific audit or validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact exterior-basis-state classification only for uniformly weighted joins of a clique and independent set, with nonnegative internal weights and positive cross weights; not a classification of all weighted graphs or arbitrary start states. Potential subsumption by broader join spectral methods remains a literature risk.
title: Exterior-state adjacency–Laplacian equivalence on weighted split joins
